client.name: Adrian Tan
client.background: Adrian Tan is a private-banking client who runs a regional trading business and follows Asian equity markets closely. He prefers concise conversations and keeps his holding records nearby when giving instructions.
client.investment_objective: Reduce exposure to Asian equities and preserve liquidity for business needs.
client.loss_attitude: He is uncomfortable with further declines in his existing holding and prefers reducing exposure rather than waiting for a recovery.

setting.call_reason: The client calls to reduce his existing fund holding, seeking liquidity and less regional equity exposure; confidential information about a portfolio company also directly motivates his instruction.
setting.conversation_style: Brief, businesslike Singapore English, with the client speaking quickly at first and becoming more deliberate when identifying the holding and settling the instruction.

final_product.description: Meridian Asia Equity Fund is an equity fund providing exposure to companies across Asian markets.
concrete_risks: The fund's value can decline when Asian equity markets weaken or the companies in its portfolio report disappointing results.
Regional concentration makes the fund sensitive to political, regulatory and economic developments affecting Asian markets.
Market volatility can affect the value realised when the holding is sold.
final_product.recommendation_basis: Reducing the existing holding lowers the client's exposure to Asian equity volatility and releases liquidity for his business needs.

parsed_response.holding_context: The client holds Meridian Asia Equity Fund in his investment account and wants to reduce that existing position.

red_flags.C10: The client's sell instruction is explicitly motivated by confidential, unreleased information received from a senior executive at a company held by the fund about a material deterioration in its business that will be announced publicly.

edge_case_context.motivation: The client begins naming the holding from memory, then restarts to use the full name shown on his holding record so the instruction is precise.

additional_discussion_topics: The client's preference for telephone appointments
Recent changes in the client's work routine
